newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldovan inflation jumps to 1.5 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Moldovan inflation jumps to 1.5 pct in Sept.

text.p: Moldovan consumer prices rose 1.5 percent in September after falling 0.3 percent in August, an official from the State Statistics Department told Reuters.
Fast-growing passenger transport tariffs and a poor harvest caused by this year's severe drought accounted for the steep rise of prices in September, the official said.
MOLDOVAN CONSUMER PRICES Sept '96 Aug '96 Sept '95
Consumer prices in the first nine months of 1996 grew by 10.8 percent. The National Bank expects annual inflation to drop this year to 15-17 percent from 23.8 percent in 1995.
